subject: general
question: Which of the following options is the closest approximate value which will come in place of question mark(?) in the following equation? sqrt {1025} + 98 ÷ 14 × 4 - sqrt {170} =?
solution:
**Given:**

**sqrt {1025} + 98 ÷ 14 × 4 - sqrt {170} =?**

**Formula Used:**

√(x) denotes the square root of x.

**Calculation:**

Approximate value of √(1025) ≈ 32

Approximate value of √(170) ≈ 13

98 ÷ 14 = 7

7 × 4 = 28

Combining all parts:

⇒ 32 + 28 - 13

⇒ 60 - 13

⇒ 47

**The closest approximate value is 47.**
